description: Open Development Cambodia (ODC) is a data repository run by Open Development Cambodia (East-West Management Institute). ODC is a site with thousands of datasets, maps and briefings on Cambodia, including hydropower and other energy projects, roads and railways, irrigation, land concessions and floods, mostly as downloadable tables and maps. Coverage: Cambodia. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as csv, shp; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("Open Development Cambodia (ODC)") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support infrastructure planning and flood studies of Cambodia. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
